name: Tharnaka
description: Tharnaka was a planet that housed the artifact Tharnakan Story Stone. It was the native planet of the Tharnakan species. Long before 233 BBY, the climate on Tharnaka changed, causing a flood to descend on the entire planet. As a result, the vast plains and hilly landscapes of the planet disappeared without a trace.
lead_paragraphs: Tharnaka was a planet that housed the artifact Tharnakan Story Stone. It was the native planet of the Tharnakan species.
